prompts.body:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one final-contact sprite for a TWO-DRAWING fighting-game animation (original idle, then this final pose).
Input image 1 is the exact original idle character identity and rendering master. Image 2 is an approved alternate attack showing how the same character's thin plain crew-neck T-shirt looks during torso rotation.
Preserve this exact narrow angry gaunt face, hair silhouette and short spikes (not a huge fan), body proportions, low plain crew-neck short sleeve T-shirt, loose trousers, boots, muted copper/mauve colors, scratchy uneven dark ink outlines and fine dense diagonal crosshatching. It is rough serious Comix Zone type art, not a polished cartoon. No hoodie, no cowl, no tall collar, no shoulder pads. Single full body character facing RIGHT, transparent background, fully visible boots, same side-view camera. No text, no effects, no extra hands or people. Keep the forward boot planted in the same position and orientation as idle. Arm has human proportions, never stretch for reach. The non-striking hand guards the jaw.
Primary requested edit: Powerful body hook final contact: bend the knees moderately, drop hips about one head-half relative to idle, rotate hips and near shoulder into the strike. Near arm bent roughly 105 degrees, fist drives forward and slightly upward into opponent's stomach at lower chest/waist height, elbow below fist. Fist must project farther right than the head and guard, making the attack unmistakable, not a biceps flex pose. The torso and bent legs visibly supply the punch's weight. Keep source facial features and small crew-neck intact.
